about: Blind call set (27 Nov 2026), written BEFORE the intent-frame layer was coded and evaluated once, with no tuning afterwards. Team-written, small; it complements scam_eval.json (rules were designed on it) and scam_eval_heldout.json (its errors were seen before the frame layer was designed).

calls.label: scam
utterances: Namaste, this is the gas agency.
Your gas connection will be stopped from tomorrow because of a pending penalty.
Pay two hundred rupees on this number now to keep it active.

calls.label: scam
utterances: You are eligible for an income tax refund of eighteen thousand rupees.
Tell me the code that comes on your phone so we can credit it.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Your insurance policy has a maturity bonus waiting.

calls.label: scam
utterances: I am an army officer, I want to rent your flat.
